title: Government Presents 2027 Social Security Budget Targeting Deficit Halving with Austerity Measures
detail: The French government presented the 2027 social security budget with the goal of halving the social security deficit, demanding austerity efforts across sectors as part of broader fiscal consolidation under PM Lecornu's 'redressement' program. The plan follows warnings of financial crisis risk issued days earlier.

title: High School Student Protest Movement Spreads from Paris Suburbs to Lille and Marseille
detail: A high school student protest movement that began in the Paris suburbs has spread to Lille and Marseille, widening across France and occasionally becoming overrun by incidents of disorder.

title: Second Left-Wing Primary Debate: Tensions Rise Over Gaza and Use of Term 'Genocide'
detail: The second debate of the left-wing primary was held between candidates Faure, Glucksmann, Royal, Guedj and Maurel. Tensions rose sharply over the situation in Gaza and whether to use the word 'genocide' to describe events there.
